summary.text: Patrick A. Hope is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 1st District, which covers part of Arlington County, and has served since 2010.
Hope sits on the House committees on Courts of Justice, Public Safety, Health and Human Services and Rules.

paragraphs.text: Patrick A. Hope was born in San Antonio, TX, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Hope's education as St. Mary's University, TX (B.A., 1993); The Catholic University of America, Washington, DC (M.A., 1996); The Catholic University of America Columbus School of Law, Washington, DC (J.D., 2001).
The profile gives Hope's occupation as attorney.

Hope's listed memberships and affiliations include St. Charles Borromeo Catholic Church; Virginia Health Workforce Development Authority; Virginia Health Reform Initiative Advisory Council; Virginia School and Campus Safety Task Force; Buckingham Community Civic Association (founding president); Arlington County Community Services Board (former chairman).
